prompt: Research one European rearmament and allied replenishment investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: European rearmament and persistent allied replenishment may create a multi-year demand tailwind for missiles, air defence, engines, and sensors.
inputs.drivers: EU defence budgets; munitions replenishment; allied burden sharing; supply-chain capacity; geopolitical risk.
inputs.value_chain: Defence primes; aerospace suppliers; missiles; radars; engines.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed cites estimated 2026 EU defence spending of EUR 454 billion, investment of EUR 163 billion, and RTX backlog and outlook evidence.
inputs.invalidation: Budget execution delays, ceasefires, procurement reform, cost overruns, or fixed-price contract pressure.
